UK man jailed for ₹2.54 crore crypto SIM-swap fraud

A 25-year-old man from the UK has been sentenced to two-and-a-half years in prison for a SIM-swap fraud that resulted in a ₹2.54 crore cryptocurrency heist. He pleaded guilty to the charges. The stolen funds were allegedly spent on luxury items and experiences, including gold-plated teeth, a luxury flat, and trips to Dubai.
